records.plant_name: Alliance Cloud Services Dowagiac data center gas plant
records.monitor_reason: A data center in Dowagiac plans about 40 MW of on-site gas power. That is under the 50 MW threshold, and the generating equipment has not been named.

verifications.note: Names Dowagiac and 40MW of behind-the-meter gas.

records.researcher_notes: A DatacenterDynamics article from February 28, 2025 says Hyperscale Data plans to grow its Alliance Cloud Services data center in Dowagiac, Cass County, to 340 MW. About 40 MW would come from natural gas through a behind-the-meter deal with an unnamed local gas provider. The site is 415 East Prairie Ronde Street. The state air permit to install PTI0000052 covers 15 diesel emergency generators of 2,000 kilowatts each, 30 MW in all, which is under the threshold. Searches found no air permit, turbine or engine type, or unit count for the gas power. Not found: the generator type, maker, number of units and start date.
